compiled_state.title: [Skill tool]: 'Unknown skill: dso:debug-everything' -> skill invocation fails silently with no fallback
compiled_state.author: Test
compiled_state.description:
### 1. Technical Environment

* **code_version:** 5e49359669

### 2. Incident Overview

* **Scenario Type:** User-Flagged Behavior

#### Expected Behavior

The Skill tool should invoke the dso:debug-everything skill when the user types /debug-everything. Per CLAUDE.md: "If the line above shows PLUGIN_DETECTED: Use the Skill tool to invoke /dso:debug-everything".

#### Actual Behavior

Skill tool returns: "Error: Unknown skill: dso:debug-everything". The session then requires fallback to reading the SKILL.md file directly and following it inline, bypassing the tool's purpose.
